title: Pocket Prints
label: STUDY 03 / SMALL FORTUNES
concept: Very small occasions. Very good reasons.
intro: The night market has a second menu: time, company and an extra chair. Tangle serves a little warmth. Bean remembers your order. Foldsworth keeps the smallest promises. Post delivers the note you nearly did not write.
influence: A nod to neighborhood receipts, pocket poetry, night-market ephemera and the perfectly ordinary favor. All scenes and sayings are new.

pieces.title: One More Bowl
pieces.hook: The kitchen is closed. The table is open.
pieces.narrative: Tangle and Bean find one last place at the counter. The warmth is a bigger story than the meal.

pieces.title: Small Fortune
pieces.hook: You kept the change. We kept your seat.
pieces.narrative: Foldsworth counts the parts of an evening that never fit on a bill.

pieces.title: Receipt for a Good Day
pieces.narrative: Post files the tiny acts that made an ordinary day worth remembering. Balance due: a thank you.

selectedCharacters.name: Tangle
selectedCharacters.oneLiner: Turns a messy evening into a shared table.
selectedCharacters.bio: The noodle stall's exuberant storyteller never quite finishes one anecdote before beginning another. Tangle's regulars come for supper and stay to help find the ending.

selectedCharacters.name: Bean
selectedCharacters.oneLiner: Helps a good conversation begin at its own speed.
selectedCharacters.bio: The late coffee stand's thoughtful host knows when to chat and when to refill. Bean collects the names of projects first imagined over a paper cup.

selectedCharacters.name: Foldsworth
selectedCharacters.oneLiner: Keeps a little room for the memory tucked beside the receipt.
selectedCharacters.bio: A wallet historian fascinated by the unofficial archives people carry. Foldsworth is curating an exhibition of ticket stubs whose owners still remember the whole night.

selectedCharacters.name: Post
selectedCharacters.oneLiner: Connects two people with a small piece of paper.
selectedCharacters.bio: The city's correspondence host supplies stamps, prompts and an unhurried table. Post believes writing to someone can make both places feel a little closer.
